<thought>Based on the observed isotopic spacing (~1.003 Da) and the relative intensities (M+1 ≈ 20 % of M, M+2 ≈ 2 % of M, etc.), the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing many carbons. No other element shows a characteristic isotopic pattern in this spectrum, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
